meta.purpose: An empty but strictly defined campaign ledger. Rows are added only from authorised first-party reports, never from estimates, benchmarks or projections.
meta.note: Zero rows is the correct starting state. No traffic, click, order or revenue figure has been observed for this site, so none is recorded or implied.

schema.rule: The date the report covers, not the date it was read.
The report the number came from. Must be an authorised first-party system: Associates dashboard, Creators API, or the self-hosted collector. No third-party estimates.
Where the traffic came from: organic search, direct, referral, email. Must be reported by the system, not inferred.
The page the session started on. Use the path, not a tracking URL.
Only sessions that could have produced a qualifying purchase. Leave blank if the report does not distinguish them.
Clicks recorded by our own collector. Do not substitute Amazon's click report here; it measures something else.
Ordered items as reported by Amazon, with the report date. Not a conversion rate until both sides are measured over the same window.
Commission income as reported, in USD, with the month it was earned. Payments arrive about 60 days later; record the earning month, not the payment date.
Who pulled the number, from which system, and when. A row without this field is invalid and must be deleted.
